summary: Preserve ticket index changes with three-way merging and cross-platform durability checks

delivery.outcome: Preserve independent ticket-index additions, edits and deletions through three-way merging, keep conflicts explicit, and run ticket-index and continuity durability suites on Linux and Windows in immutable standard 0.20.62. Diagnose and explicitly defer Registry Windows URL canonicalization to a dependent ticket.
nonGoals: Add runtime dependencies or mutate foreign checkouts
Silently choose a conflicting ticket row
Fix or claim passing Registry Windows canonical URLs; defer to a separate dependent runtime ticket.

architecture.decision: Use ancestor-aware selection for ticket rows and surrounding content, with Git merge-file fallback for conflicts. Run ticket-index and continuity storage regressions on Linux and Windows. Keep captured Registry regressions on Linux and exact-byte controlled diagnostics; Windows Registry fails on Python/Node URL canonicalization and its runtime fix plus Windows wiring belong to a dependent ticket.
interfaceChanges: Extend the existing Linux and Windows workflow steps with explicit durability regression suites; required job identities remain the same.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Real merge-file regressions preserve deletions, additions and target-owned text, surface conflicts and reject ambiguity. Linux runs all three suites; Windows runs ticket-index and continuity. Registry Windows failure is retained as diagnostic evidence and explicitly deferred with its runtime fix.
Native governance and required CI pass without changing protected authority.
Independent exact-head merge and final immutable standard v0.20.62 release are verified.
